from pathlib import Path
import csv,hashlib,importlib.util,json,math
p=Path('$SOURCE_WORKTREE/media/results/2026-11-05-sustained-codecs')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('metrics',Path('$CHECKOUT/media/tools/run-matched-codecs.py'));module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
d=json.loads((p/'summary.json').read_text());raw={'samples':0,'ssim':0,'foreground':0}
for c in d['cases']:
 rows=list(csv.DictReader((p/(c['name']+'-samples.csv')).open()))
 assert len(rows)==9000
 assert all(int(r['observedFrame'])==i and int(r['captureFrame'])==900+i and int(r['sourceFrame'])==30+i%240 for i,r in enumerate(rows))
 raw['samples']+=len(rows);sizes=[int(r['annexBBytes'])for r in rows];lat=sorted(float(r['encodeCallbackMs'])for r in rows)
 assert sum(sizes)==c['accessUnits']['observedAnnexBBytes'];assert lat[8549]==c['encodeLatencyMs']['p95']
 for label in ['full','text','thin']:
  parsed=module.parse_ssim(p/(c['name']+'-'+label+'.ssim'),9000);assert parsed==c['quality'][label];raw['ssim']+=parsed['frames']
for label,c in d['foreground']['variants'].items():
 rows=list(csv.DictReader((p/(label+'-foreground.csv')).open()));assert len(rows)==9000;raw['foreground']+=len(rows)
 errors=[(int(r['rErrorSum'])+int(r['gErrorSum'])+int(r['bErrorSum']))/(9792*3)for r in rows]
 assert sum(sorted(errors))/9000==c['meanAbsoluteForegroundRgbCodeError']
base,hevc=d['cases'];assert d['observedAnnexBReductionFraction']==1-hevc['accessUnits']['observedAnnexBBytes']/base['accessUnits']['observedAnnexBBytes']
assert raw=={'samples':18000,'ssim':54000,'foreground':27000}
print(json.dumps({'source':d['source'],'rowCounts':raw,'exactDerivedMetricReproduction':True}))
